title: Container
description: Layout container that is a flex stack at one column and a responsive auto-fit grid at two or more.

direction.description: Flow of the children at one column: column stacks them, row lines them up side by side. Ignored in grid mode.

columns.description: 1 is a flex stack or row. 2 or more switches to a responsive grid whose columns auto-fit down to one on narrow screens.

gap.description: Space between the children, as any CSS length.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment of the children: start, center, end or stretch.

justify.description: Main-axis placement of the children: start, center, end, space-between, space-around or space-evenly.

padding.description: Space inside the container around its children, as any CSS length.

maxWidth.description: Widest the container may grow; it is then centred. Any CSS length.

wrap.description: Let a row wrap onto more lines when it runs out of room. wrap="false" keeps every child on one line.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
